svg.title: AI systems — Agent Harness, RAG Engine, Automation Mesh
svg.desc: Three systems shown as model cards on deep-space starfields. Agent Harness: Agents in parallel 100+; Roles plan · build · review · verify; Runtime Claude Code · Codex · SDKs. RAG Engine: Retrieval embeddings · hybrid search; Stores pgvector · Pinecone · Redis; Quality reranking · evals · citations. Automation Mesh: Triggers webhooks · queues · cron; Tools MCP · function calling; Delivery GitHub Actions · serverless.
